prerequisites.capability: familiarity with basic commercial contract structure and terminology
prerequisites.rationale: Without baseline contract literacy a learner cannot segment or interpret clause language well enough to assign risk categories (obj-lcr-01) or identify and reason about risks in clause text (obj-lcr-02). Both tasks presuppose that the learner can locate, read, and parse discrete clauses; a deficit here blocks task engagement independently of whether the target capability is present, making assessment evidence uninterpretable.

Commercial contract clauses are written in a formal legal register whose syntax and diction differ substantially from general prose. Inability to decode this register would confound performance on the categorization task (obj-lcr-01, asmt-lcr-01-formative) and the risk-identification task (obj-lcr-02, asmt-lcr-02-summative) independently of the target capability, producing assessment evidence that cannot be attributed to contractual-risk knowledge rather than reading difficulty.

modules.title: Identifying and Reasoning About Risks in Contract Clauses

sequencing_rationale: Module 1 addresses the understand-level conceptual objective (obj-lcr-01) before Module 2 because the supplied objectives record obj-lcr-01 as a prerequisite of obj-lcr-02.

The 60-minute budget is allocated approximately 25 minutes to the understand-level module and 35 minutes to the apply-level module; this split is a model-proposed candidate and must be confirmed by the researcher.

Both entry prerequisites (prereq-contract-literacy-01, prereq-legal-register-reading-01) are treated as course-level entry gates, not instructional targets within this outline, consistent with their classification as required_prerequisites in the supplied artifacts.

assumption_notes: Module time allocations (25 min / 35 min) are model-proposed candidates; the researcher must confirm or adjust.
Module IDs (mod-lcr-01, mod-lcr-02) are model-proposed and are not drawn from a researcher-authored ID registry.
lesson_ids are left empty; lesson generation and ID assignment are delegated to the orchestration layer per schema instruction.
The two entry prerequisites are assumed to be verified before course start and are not taught within this outline.

lessons.lesson_goal: Introduce the taxonomy of common commercial contract risk categories so the learner can name and distinguish each category and identify the boundary between risk identification and legal judgment.
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Read or view a structured presentation of the risk category taxonomy; identify the distinguishing features of each category; note how the taxonomy boundary separates risk identification from legal conclusion.

assumption_notes: Taxonomy content, category names, and presentation format are not specified in the supplied artifacts; researcher must supply.
Estimated 12 minutes is a candidate allocation within the 25-minute mod-lcr-01 budget; researcher must confirm.

lessons.lesson_goal: Check learner ability to map clause language to risk categories using the provided taxonomy before progressing to the apply-level module.
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Assign each of a set of short commercial clause excerpts to one or more risk categories from the provided taxonomy; briefly state the basis for each assignment; refrain from issuing legal judgments; review feedback before proceeding.

assumption_notes: This lesson operationalizes asmt-lcr-01-formative; clause excerpts, correct mappings, and feedback mechanism must be supplied by the researcher.
Estimated 13 minutes is a candidate allocation; together with lesson-lcr-01-01 it totals the 25-minute mod-lcr-01 budget; researcher must confirm.

lessons.lesson_goal: Model the risk-identification and reasoning procedure on a sample clause so the learner can observe how to link specific clause language to a risk and stop short of issuing legal advice before attempting independent work.
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Follow a step-by-step annotated walkthrough of risk identification applied to a sample clause; compare the demonstrated reasoning statements to an initial unguided reading; note where the example explicitly declines to issue a legal conclusion.

assumption_notes: The worked-example clause and its annotated solution must be supplied by the researcher; no clause content or solution is generated here.
Sequenced before guided practice to satisfy the apply-level instruction-before-practice requirement for obj-lcr-02.
Estimated 15 minutes is a candidate allocation within the 35-minute mod-lcr-02 budget; researcher must confirm.

lessons.lesson_goal: Provide supervised practice identifying and reasoning about risks in moderately complex commercial contract clauses so the learner is prepared for the summative assessment.
lessons.expected_learner_activity: Identify potential risks in one or more provided commercial contract clauses; cite the specific clause language supporting each identification; provide a reasoning statement linking clause language to the identified risk; explicitly refrain from issuing a definitive legal conclusion; review any scaffolded prompts or hints before the summative task.

assumption_notes: Practice clauses, scaffolded prompts, and feedback must be supplied by the researcher; no clause content is generated here.
Estimated 20 minutes is a candidate allocation; combined with lesson-lcr-02-01 it totals the 35-minute mod-lcr-02 budget; researcher must confirm.
